name: Basecamp
description: Basecamp is an all-in-one project management and team communication tool that combines to-do lists, message boards, docs, and chat in one place.
best_for: Teams, companies, and nonprofits who want centralized project coordination instead of scattered email, chat apps, and browser tabs.
features: To-do lists with assignments and due dates
Card table for Kanban-style workflow tracking
Hill charts for visualizing project progress
Campfire group chat for real-time messaging
Automatic check-in questions for async updates

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: One project, 1 GB storage, and up to 5 users.

tiers.name: Freelancer
tiers.notes: Up to 3 active projects, 5 GB storage, and up to 20 users; 30-day free trial.

tiers.name: Studio
tiers.notes: Up to 10 active projects, 25 GB storage, and unlimited users; 30-day free trial.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Up to 25 active projects, 100 GB storage, and unlimited users; 30-day free trial.

tiers.name: Unlimited
tiers.notes: Per month, billed annually; unlimited projects and users, 1 TB storage, and a 45-day free trial.

alternatives.name: Asana
alternatives.description: A work management platform for tracking tasks, projects, and cross-team workflows.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that need structured task tracking and workflow automation

alternatives.name: Teamwork
alternatives.description: A project management platform built for client services teams to manage projects, time, and budgets.
alternatives.best_for: Agencies and client-services businesses tracking profitability

alternatives.name: Trello
alternatives.description: A visual, card-based tool for organizing tasks and workflows on Kanban boards.
alternatives.best_for: Small teams wanting a simple visual task board

alternatives.name: Zoho Projects
alternatives.description: An online project management platform for planning, tracking, and collaborating on work, with deep integration into the wider Zoho suite.
alternatives.best_for: Teams already using Zoho apps, and organizations wanting an affordable, feature-rich project tool
